findings.claim: No test anywhere in the suite calls `create_run` with a non-None `batch_id` and checks it lands in the row — every call site (session.py, replay.py, and every test including the two new ones) uses the default. Changing `(repo_id, base_sha, batch_id)` to `(repo_id, base_sha, None)` on this line would silently drop the grouping value on every real invocation and the full test suite, including the new batches/runs tests, would stay green, since the only assertion made is that the column is NULL when no batch_id is passed.
